description_en: Changes the name of a Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance
description_zh: 修改负载均衡实例的名称
kebab_example: aliyun slb set-load-balancer-name --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-bp1b6c719dfa08e000000 --load-balancer-name test1 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetLoadBalancerName

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the CLB instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the CLB instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the CLB instance.

The name must be 1 to 80 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的新名称。

长度为1～80个英文、数字或中文字符，可包含半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: load_balancer_name
